source_review.notes: Checked the primary 1977 SIAM KMP paper and its publication metadata, official Cambridge publisher records and DOIs for three string-algorithm monographs, and the official MIT Press fourth-edition record. The chapter makes no runtime-specific algorithm claim.

evidence: Checked pattern, text, half-open slice, proper-border, prefix-function, matched-length, failure-chain, absolute-coordinate, output-size, and complexity notation; checked balanced GitHub math delimiters.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Prefix values are consistently lengths, while text coordinates are zero-based indices or consumed-symbol counts as labeled.

evidence: Recomputed prefix tables for ababaca, aaa, abab, and aabaaab.
Recomputed resident match shift 6, overlapping shifts (0, 2), cross-chunk shift 6, and the count-to-index correction consumed-m.
Exhaustively checked 15,810 nonempty binary pattern/text cases through pattern length 5 and text length 7 against direct matching and brute-force prefix values.
numerical_recomputation.notes: All exhaustive prefix and search comparisons agreed.

evidence: Re-derived that every surviving mismatch candidate is a border of the matched prefix and is enumerated by repeated pi[q-1].
Re-derived prefix-construction and search induction steps.
Re-derived O(m+n+z) time using matched length q as a potential and O(m) matcher state excluding output.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The proof explicitly assumes stable constant-time equality and a nonempty pattern.

evidence: Checked length-one patterns, pattern longer than text, no matches, overlaps, all-position matches, deep borders, mismatch at q=0, full-match fallback, and end-of-input.
Checked empty-pattern policy, arbitrary stream partitions, mutable patterns, pattern-version mismatch, decoder tails, restart boundaries, output floods, bounded queues, and variable-cost equality.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: The streaming implementation rejects empty patterns explicitly; finite all-boundaries semantics remain a separate valid API.

evidence: Checked exact prior prefix values, border validity, eliminated longer candidates, and strict failure decrease during preprocessing.
Checked longest suffix-prefix state, exact-once reports, q<m before access, post-match border retention, absolute consumed count, and state persistence across chunks.
invariant_checking.notes: Immutable compiled pattern state is separated from per-stream mutable state.

evidence: Reviewed the prefix-function theorem's base and inductive cases.
Reviewed KMP soundness, completeness, overlap handling, no-text-backtracking claim, and amortized comparison bound.
Reviewed DFA interpretation and the hypotheses behind its memory comparison.
proof_review.notes: Output cost, preprocessing, transformation, and matcher storage are not conflated.

evidence: Audited uses of theorem, proof, exact, complete, sound, linear, deterministic, invariant, exhaustive, and exactly once.
Separated mathematical results from snippet execution, finite testing, benchmarks, lifecycle protocol, and product policy.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Exactly-once delivery is presented as a protocol design requiring atomicity or idempotency, not as a KMP guarantee.

evidence: The CPython 3.14.4 snippet exited zero with the expected prefix table, resident match, overlapping matches, and partitioned-stream match on macOS 13.7.8 x86_64.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: The run establishes observed behavior only; it does not prove all-input correctness or production throughput.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed border foundations, prefix preprocessing, failure-state semantics, overlap transition, two invariants, amortized proofs, automaton interpretation, compiled-pattern ownership, and stream lifecycle. Scope remains single-pattern KMP and leaves skip-based search to ALGE-053.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed convention mismatch, index safety, pattern mutation, thread sharing, chunk persistence, absolute coordinates, decoder/checkpoint state, versioning, backpressure, result limits, mutation testing, and benchmark design.

pedagogical_review.notes: The Level-II chapter derives KMP rather than presenting memorized loops, contains ten distinct formal, trace, diagnosis, architecture, streaming, and operational examples, and ends with five progressive exercises and complete answers.

limitations: Internal source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical review only; no external academic, security, performance, distributed-systems, localization, or operational review is claimed. Results remain conditional on stable pattern content, sequence/equality semantics, resource limits, and lifecycle assumptions.
